interventions.detail: Installed CPU-only torch/torchvision from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu in a uv Python 3.12 venv before pip install -e .
Example hardcodes rand_device='cuda'; made CPU copy with rand_device='cpu', device='cpu', 20 steps
Pre-downloaded SD1.5 text_encoder/unet/vae/tokenizer from ModelScope into ./models and run from repo root (relative model path)
